mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL is rising, but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% YoY signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST YoY > 10% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY and the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3%, it signals a potential economic slowdown with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: late-cycle slowdown with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If GDPC1 YoY < 1% and FEDFUNDS > 3%, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.
